settings.title: Dada Todo List Settings
settings.openLocationDesc: Choose where the panel opens: left sidebar, main window tab, or right sidebar. Changes apply immediately.
settings.showLunarDesc: Show lunar dates, solar terms, festivals and statutory holiday badges in day / week / month views. Turn off to show Gregorian dates only.
settings.weekStartDesc: The first column of the week view and month calendar follows this. Choose Sunday through Saturday; default Monday.
settings.colorSchemeDesc: Color scheme for task blocks in the timeline, calendar, and other views.
settings.timelineRangeDesc: Day / week views show only this span on the timeline (whole hours, 0–24). End must be later than start. Default 00:00–24:00 (full day). Timed tasks outside the window are hidden from the timeline.
settings.inboxFileDesc: Where tasks without a date are stored (path relative to vault root, your choice). Created automatically on startup if missing.
settings.journalFolderDesc: Folder holding your journals (dated tasks). The plugin scans this folder and its subfolders for notes whose filename contains a date (e.g. 2026-10-03, 2026-10-03-Sat, 10-03-2026, with Chinese weekday or any prefix/suffix). Default / means the vault root. Matching is loose; point it at a journals-only folder for best accuracy.
settings.journalLooseMatchDesc: On by default. When on, a date is extracted from anywhere in the filename, tolerating personalized naming (e.g. 2026-10-03-Sat, 10-03-2026, with weekday or any prefix/suffix). When off, only files whose name starts with a date (or "weekday-date") are treated as journals, avoiding mis-detecting ordinary notes that merely contain a date.
settings.inboxMoveAsk: The old inbox still has {{n}} task(s). Move them to the new file?
settings.inboxMoved: Moved {{n}} task(s) to the new inbox
settings.dailyWindowDesc: Only load daily notes within N days before and after today (tasks earlier or later than that won't appear in the panel). Lower this on large vaults for better performance; choose "All" for full history. Default: All.
settings.checklistTagDesc: Add one or more tags. Notes whose frontmatter tags include any of them (or a sub-tag like todoList/work) are treated as checklists.
settings.tagPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
